items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this for a premium documentary YouTube Shorts channel about money, history and the tricks behind them. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller with a hint of mystery: curious, quietly amused, energetic and punchy, never slow, never announcer-like. Natural emphasis on dates and numbers, questions end with a curious lift, a short comic pause before each punchline. Keep the same voice, pace and energy from start to finish. Chars voices two funny cartoon characters (a smug gold bar and a nervous banknote), short and punchy, performed exactly as described in each bracket.
lines: Narrator
Your shop could lose money to a screenshot. Over two hundred shopkeepers already did. Would you spot it?
Narrator
"Payment successful." Green tick. Even a ding. This month, police in Punjab arrested two men for faking it.
Chars
[nervous, squeaky banknote, trembling] I never even left his wallet.
Narrator
So how do you get paid... without paying?
Narrator
A fake app that copies a real payment screen, sound and all.
Narrator
Or an edited screenshot. Sometimes a fake bank SMS.
Narrator
One man in Delhi told police he fooled over two hundred this way.
Narrator
And the trick works best when you're busiest.
Narrator
A rush. A queue. No time to check.
Narrator
That's the mirage: the screen in his hand isn't your bank.
Narrator
India runs about half the world's real-time payments. Scammers love volume.
Chars
[smug, deep, rich gold bar, very pleased with himself] Never trust a screen. Trust a vault.
Narrator
So before the goods leave, check your app. Not theirs.
Narrator
Comment: do you check every payment?
Narrator
This is Money Mirage. Follow for more.
